_comment: ROM identification and table offsets for the four English GBA releases. Source: STulling/Medabots-Randomizer (MIT), see NOTICE. Offsets are file offsets; 'header_id' is the 18 bytes at header_offset (12-byte title + 4-byte game code + 2-byte maker code).

unsupported_header_prefixes.MEDACORE: This is a Japanese Medarot ROM. Only the English Medabots: Metabee / Rokusho ROMs are supported.
unsupported_header_prefixes.MEDABOTSAX: This is Medabots AX, a different game. Only Medabots: Metabee / Rokusho is supported.

signatures._comment: Byte patterns that locate tables inside any of the four ROMs (first match). 'event_scripts' is the start of the script bytecode region.
